promise: Microsoft was working toward closing its Activision Blizzard acquisition in fiscal 2023, subject to regulatory approvals.
description: Microsoft said in January 2023 that it was working toward an FY2023 close, subject to regulatory approvals. The acquisition closed October 13, 2023, after the June fiscal year-end.
evidence: January earnings transcript retains regulatory-approval condition.
Official October 13 employee announcement confirms completion.

promise: Twitter has a chance of becoming cash-flow positive in Q2 2023
description: On March 7, 2023, Musk said Twitter had a chance of positive cash flow the following quarter. In July he said cash flow remained negative, citing advertising weakness and debt.
evidence: Musk's July admission indicated the Q2 cash-flow expectation was missed.
